rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a Roberts- or Kavanaugh-authored opinion holding that, given the ATS’s jurisdictional text and Sosa/Jesner/Nestlé’s separation-of-powers caution, federal courts should not recognize ATS aiding-and-abetting liability absent clear congressional authorization, with the TVPA reinforcing that inference. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas (originalist limits on federal common law) and from the dissenters (arguing aiding-and-abetting is a norm-embedded mode of liability within Sosa’s framework rather than an impermissible expansion).
